people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Nathan
people.line: Prophet during the reigns of David and Solomon.

translations.web: Nathan departed to his house. Yahweh struck the child that Uriah’s wife bore to David, and it was very sick.
translations.bsb: After Nathan had gone home, the LORD struck the child that Uriah’s wife had borne to David, and he became ill.
translations.kjv: And Nathan departed unto his house. And the LORD struck the child that Uriah's wife bare unto David, and it was very sick.
translations.asv: And Nathan departed unto his house. And Jehovah struck the child that Uriah's wife bare unto David, and it was very sick.
